newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover surged to 4.964 billion yuan from 1.396 billion yuan with the 90-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said volume surged due to month-end demand as both state-run banks and non-banking financial institutions traded actively.
"Both state banks and non-banking financial institutions need lots of short-term funds to balance their books," said one trader.
"The interbank market is the best place for them to borrow short-term money, and that meant very active trading today," he said.
Demand for the medium-term funds also increased with heavy institutional borrowing, traders said, adding that demand for later maturing contracts was also strong.
Traders said they expected volume to fall in the next few days, but with rates holding around current levels.
